fact: The Ministry of ICT states the AI strategy was refined through National Multi-Stakeholder Consultations held in Harare on 28 August 2025 and in Bulawayo and Masvingo on 9 and 11 September 2025, and lists the stakeholders consulted.
title: Zimbabwe National Artificial Intelligence (AI) Strategy 2026-2030
publisher: Ministry of Information Communication Technology, Postal and Courier Services
